description.narrative: Create a network for learning and sharing of protocols and processes to identify solutions, experiment and generate collective intelligence.

sector.narrative: Structural transformation, including green, inclusive and digital transitions

condition.narrative: UNDP as the Implementing Partner will comply with the policies, procedures and practices of the United Nations Security Management System (UNSMS.)

description.narrative:
Output 1: UNDP Country Offices and partners will have increased capability for scanning, sensemaking and experimentation for sustainable development solutions in 60 developing countries.
1.1 Number of new data sources used at Country Office level. 1.2 Diversity of different data sources used 1.3 Number of sustainable development solutions identified and documented 1.4 Variety of innovation methods used to test and iterate over the different hypotheses.
Output 2: New sustainable development solutions will be scaled at country level as part of UNDP’s country programme and operations, national policy and/or local markets.
2.1 Learning the Accelerator Lab Network shares with a public audience (outside of UNDP) 2.2 Number of lab insights, processes or products which are taken up by governments or other partners 2.3 Proportion of partners and governments that increase their take up of the innovation methods included in the Accelerator Lab Network suite 2.4 Proportion of UNDP Country Office programming influenced by the Accelerator Lab Network’s work and methodologies
Output 3: A core global level result will be that a global learning and scaling network is established and functioning.
3.1 Size and density of the network effects among the Accelerator Labs 3.2 Number of new models, approaches, and insights documented and disseminated throughout the network. 3.3 Engagement of the broader development ecosystem with published learnings from the Accelerator Lab Network. 3.4 Amount of influence the learnings and methods of the Accelerator Lab Networks have on the discourse of the broader development ecosystem.

title.narrative: 2.2 Proportion of patterns turned into value propositions at a global and regional level

description.narrative: Cumulative. Value propositions outline an emerging opportunity for sustainable development unearthed from country level practice. It normally takes the form of an emerging programme niche, seen as having the potential to pursue the Sustainable Development Goals more broadly, effectively or efficiently. The journey from pattern to value proposition is one way the UNDP Accelerator Labs conceptualizes its R&D cycle.

title.narrative: 2.1 Proportion of patterns codified as insights at a global and regional level

description.narrative: Patterns are activities that emerge in similar ways through Lab practice in several different countries. They point to interest for the same phenomenon beyond the local context. A pattern requires either breadth (over 10 labs) or depth (evidence of scaling). Insights are new knowledge on a sustainable development issue that is actionable through programs, investment, coordination on the ground.

title.narrative: 2.3 Proportion of governments that increase their take up of the innovation methods included in the Accelerator Lab Network suite

description.narrative: The indicator "Proportion of governments that increase their take up of the innovation methods included in the Accelerator Lab Network suite" indicates the proportion of national or local governments that gradually adopt and make use of the different innovation methodologies that are part of the suite that the UNDP's Accelerator Lab Network offers. It evaluates how much government organizations incorporate and apply these cutting-edge techniques, instruments, and frameworks into their frameworks for service delivery, development plans, and policymaking. This indicator shows the dissemination and adoption of cutting-edge methods in governance and development processes by reflecting the impact and uptake of Accelerator Lab Network methodologies inside government organizations.

title.narrative: 2.1 Learning the Accelerator Lab Network shares with a public audience (outside of UNDP)

description.narrative: The UNDP's Accelerator Lab Network generates insights, information, and discoveries that are shared with external stakeholders outside of the UNDP community. This is measured by the indicator "Learning the Accelerator Lab Network shares with a public audience (outside of UNDP)". It assesses how well the Accelerator Labs collaborate, communicate, and share their discoveries, lessons learned, creative approaches, and solutions with a larger public audience, promoting openness, impactful idea amplification beyond internal bounds, and transparency.

title.narrative: 1.3 Number of sustainable development solutions identified and documented

description.narrative: The indicator "Number of sustainable development solutions identified and documented" measures the number of workable and long-lasting methods, plans, or inventions that have been identified, recorded, and maybe put into practice in order to address certain difficulties related to sustainable development. It denotes the ability to find, list, and maybe spread practical solutions that advance the objectives of sustainable development. This indicator shows the dedication to identifying problems and then documenting how to solve them, so that good techniques can be shared for a larger effect.

title.narrative: 1.1 Number of new data sources used at Country Office level.

description.narrative: The term "data sources used and reported in Action Plans" pertains to the comprehensive compilation and utilization of diverse, verified information repositories that serve as foundational pillars for devising, implementing, and documenting strategic Action Plans within a specified context or initiative.

title.narrative: 2.4 Proportion of UNDP Country Office programming influenced by the Accelerator Lab Network’s work and methodologies

description.narrative: The indicator "Proportion of UNDP Country Office programming influenced by the Accelerator Lab Network’s work and methodologies" measures the extent to which the activities, strategies, and initiatives undertaken by UNDP Country Offices are shaped or impacted by the insights, methodologies, and innovative approaches developed or facilitated by the Accelerator Lab Network. It assesses the degree of influence or integration of the Accelerator Lab Network's findings, methodologies, and innovative practices in the design, planning, and implementation of UNDP's programs at the country level. This indicator reflects the depth of impact and adoption of innovative methods within the operational framework of UNDP Country Offices, showcasing the integration of cutting-edge approaches to address development challenges.

title.narrative: 2.2 Number of lab insights, processes or products which are taken up by governments or other partners

description.narrative: The quantity of laboratory-derived insights, methodologies, or innovations embraced and implemented by governmental entities or collaborating partners

title.narrative: 1.2 Diversity of different data sources used

description.narrative: The indicator "Diversity of different data sources used" measures the variety and inclusivity of information origins utilized in a given context. It assesses the range of distinct and reliable sources contributing to the creation, analysis, and substantiation of data-driven insights or decision-making processes. This indicator underscores the importance of drawing information from multiple credible channels, ensuring a well-rounded and comprehensive understanding of the subject matter or situation under examination.

title.narrative: 1.5 Percentage of Signals in the UNDP Future Trends and Signals System that were scanned by Accelerator Lab Members

description.narrative: A nivel de laboratorio individual, el aporte es numérico. Si la plataforma UNDP Future Trends tiene 10 escaneos, éstos deben ser realizados en un % por labbers a nivel global.

title.narrative: 1.4 Variety of innovation methods used to test and iterate over the different hypotheses.

description.narrative: The indicator "variety of innovation methods used to test and iterate over different hypotheses" describes the wide range of inventive and methodical techniques that are utilized to test, validate, and improve different theories or concepts. It includes a variety of experimental procedures, systematic approaches, and iterative methods that are used to verify possible innovations, test hypotheses, and improve concepts. This indication highlights how crucial it is to use flexible yet rigorous procedures in order to investigate, test, and improve hypotheses; this encourages a dynamic and iterative approach to innovation and problem-solving.
